name: The Best
text: When you go Down, take one Full Action first.

name: Hard to Kill
text: Add a fifth Harm box, Battered, between Hurt and Wounded.

name: A Thing or Two
text: Edge on Patrol rolls in your own neighborhood.

name: Plugs
text: Once per Night, a contact gives you 1 clue, no roll. Each use ticks your Home clock or Heat (your choice).

name: Opportunist
text: Once per scene, when an enemy misses you, gain 1 Drive.

name: Fast Hands
text: Once per turn, Interact is free.

name: Resources
text: Money, a company, or a rich patron. At each Dawn you can swap any of your gear for other gear from the list. Once per Night, buying your way past a problem (a bribe, a rented space, a lawyer) counts as Impact 2 with no roll, but ticks Home by 1.

name: Acrobat
text: Hazard zones don't cost you Harm on a miss, and you can move into a zone and climb to its High Ground in the same free move.

name: Already Broken
text: Your Stress never drops below 4, so you're always Fraying and the GM always has a hook. In return, start each Night with 4 Drive instead of 2.

name: The Roast
text: Once per fight, as a Quick Action, roll Presence against a named enemy's Poise. On a hit, they take Stress equal to the Impact and the next attack against them has Edge. A Miss costs you 1 Stress: it landed badly.

name: Patient Hunter
text: Once per Night, when you take a clue, take it clean: no cost is paid, even on a Miss.

name: Sucker Punch
text: Your first attack against an enemy who hasn't acted yet has Edge.

name: Bodyguard
text: Once per round, take a hit aimed at an ally in your zone. You take 1 less Harm from it.

name: Quick Study
text: Once per scene, after a villain spends Drive on a Trick against you, you have Edge against that villain for the rest of the scene.

name: Chill
text: Once per fight, ignore one Stress you would gain, or clear 1 Stress when you roll Impact 3.

name: Rooftop Runner
text: Your free move can cross one extra zone, and you can leave a fight without a roll.

name: Smarmy
text: Once per Night, a Presence roll to talk someone down or past a door counts as one Impact higher (still capped at 3).

name: Scrapper
text: Once per scene, when you're outnumbered in your zone, your next attack has Edge and deals +1 Harm.

name: Trick Arrows
text: You need a bow as one of your weapons. Twice per fight, add one effect to a bow attack, a different arrow each time. Net: the target can't take their free move until they spend a Quick Action to get free. Flash: the target has Disadvantage on their next roll. Grapple: you move to any zone you can see, including High Ground. Boom: on a hit, everyone else in the target's zone takes 1 Harm.
